d:
Pradhanmantri narendr modi 30 disanbar 2023 ko ayodhya ki mira majhi ke parivar se milne pahunche the. vajah ye thi ki mira pradhanmantri ujjvala yojna ki 10 karorvin labharthi thin. mira ko piem aavas yojna ke tahat ghar mila, unke pati ko pradhanmantri rojgar srijan karyakram ke tahat lon mila. lekin ab ye parivar aarthik tangi se jujh raha hai. kya hai pura mamla? dekhiye ye riport.
Riport: gaurav gulmohar
Shut: kumar virendr
